acceptanceCriteria: witnessResolves rejects a DEPENDENCY_PATH whose consecutive Via units are not graph edges
a forged-edge fixture case fails before the change and passes after; a mutation dropping the edge check fails it
body: Residual from the V1-0564/0739/1234 lane (PR #966, head 11d7a7ef3, 2026-10-16). The new test helper witnessResolves in internal/liveverify/affected/measure_test.go re-derives AFP-V0-012 (a)/(b) witnesses from the public graph and checks the kind, chain shape, origin and terminal unit, but not that every consecutive pair in Via is a graph edge: a forged Via [user, app] resolves. The live-worktree test never checked edges either. Recorded as a limit in docs/build-log/2026-10-16-v1-0564-0739-1234-affected-witness-walker.md. Expected: each Via hop is an import edge in the graph.
title: tests: affected witnessResolves checks a chain's origin and end but not each Via edge, so a forged intermediate hop resolves
